question: I need an MRI of my knee. What will it cost me now?
answer: At an in-network facility, you would pay an estimated $408 for a knee MRI. The plan would pay $612. These figures are estimates based on the plan's allowed amount of $1,020. Your deductible is already met for this year, so you pay 40% coinsurance. Before the scan, you need prior authorization. Your primary care provider coordinates your care and can help start that request. Please use an in-network provider. Except for emergencies, this plan doesn't pay for out-of-network care. If you go out of network, you pay the full cost, and it won't count toward your deductible or out-of-pocket limit. Your final cost may differ once the claim is processed.
